verdict.rationale: Cline supports headless/autonomous execution, cron-scheduled agents, parallel Kanban agents with isolated worktrees, auto-commit, diff review, and inline comments, which together approximate a 'cloud agent builds/tests/demos and I review' workflow. However, there's no explicit evidence of a fully cloud-hosted (non-local) agent environment, integrated automated testing/demo generation, or a dedicated review UI beyond diff/comment viewing. missing for 10: dedicated cloud execution environment (not just local/CI runners), built-in test execution and demo artifact generation, end-to-end proof of a single autonomous run producing a reviewable demo, independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
